lines.en: Hello. This is my first flight.
Welcome! May I see your passport, please?
Here it is. I got it a month ago.
Thank you. How many bags do you have?
One. Is my luggage too heavy?
No, it's fine. Your gate is gate nine.
When does the airplane leave?
At three. Please wait at the gate until then.
lines.ko: 세 시요. 그때까지 탑승구에서 기다려 주세요.

lines.en: Okay. I will go there now. Thank you.
Enjoy your flight. The pilot is very good.
lines.ko: 즐거운 비행 되세요. 조종사가 아주 잘해요.

lines.en: Excuse me. I can't find my luggage.
I'm sorry. Which flight did you take?
Flight seven from Korea. It arrived an hour ago.
lines.ko: 한국에서 온 칠 편이에요. 한 시간 전에 도착했어요.

lines.en: What does your bag look like?
It's a big blue bag with red flowers.
lines.ko: 빨간 꽃무늬가 있는 큰 파란 가방이에요.

lines.en: Please wait here. I will check now.
Thank you. Is the airport always this busy?
Yes, until evening. Oh, here is your bag!
lines.ko: 네, 저녁까지요. 아, 여기 가방이 있어요!

lines.en: Wow, that's it! You are so kind.
You are welcome. Enjoy your stay.
